item.title: Yomibito Shirazu ~Amai Meshibe no Seichoushi~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: EXtry
  • 発売日: 2006-04-14
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 黄泉ビト知ラズ～甘い雌蕊の性徴詩～
  • 英語名: Yomibito Shirazu Amai Meshibe no Seichoushi

别名

  • 黄泉ビト知ラズ～甘い雌蕊の性徴誌～

あらすじ

There’s a school where the supernatural is commonplace, and a new style of learning has been implemented. It is called the “Ship” system, where two students learn as a very intimate team. The more trust and devotion you have for one another, the better the rewards. Even so, there is “Ship-Duels” and “Ship-Swapping” and so forth. Each “Ship” has certain attributes attributed to them, and you’ll periodically be tested on how well the two of you are doing. There are a few students that you can “Ship” with, and a potential of around 7 women to have sex with. (From Hshare)

item.title: Bishuu ~Chigyaku no Mesu Dorei~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: EXtry
  • 発売日: 2004-12-10
  • スコア: 6.659999999999999/10 (10 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 美醜 ～恥虐の牝奴隷～
  • 英語名: Bishuu Chigyaku no Mesu Dorei

あらすじ

Following the sudden death of her father, Kurise Saki becomes president of Chris, a long-established women’s underwear manufacturer.

As a beautiful female president, Saki attracts attention from all walks of life, but then a nightmare strikes her.

She is attacked, raped, and blackmailed by the hideous, mysterious Gomi Asatoshi.

The relentless days of rape and training eventually strip Saki of her pride as a woman and an elite, turning her into a female animal.

His parents’ business partners insisted on protagonist staying at the house with only women bullying him every day. The harassment continued till the day he broke the seal during shrine visit and gained great physical and mental power over women.

あらすじ

Main character holds a laboratory there, but he has a reputation of a sadist, so students avoid it. This year there are four girls who enroll to the laboratory. It becomes a great surprise for protagonist. Well, now time’s for fun.
